services.name: Adult Cut
services.description: A full grooming experience. Your cut includes a wash using shampoo and conditioner then finished with a hot towel treatment to leave you looking fresh.

services.name: Bald Razor Cut
services.description: A clean, smooth razor finish for that sharp bald look. Includes a wash with shampoo to start and a hot towel treatment to finish it off right.

services.name: Kids' Cut
services.description: A relaxed, friendly cut made for kids. Includes a wash with shampoo and conditioner, plus a hot towel finish to match the grown-up experience.

services.name: Beard Treatment
services.description: A detailed and full beard treatment, using a hot towel and finishing with beard oil for hydration and clean growth.

services.name: Line Up
services.description: A quick touch-up to sharpen your edges and clean up your hairline. Finished with a warm hot towel for that extra fresh feel.

services.name: Adult Luxury Cut

services.name: Luxurious Razor Bald Cut
